Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Fold's Cards empty state - a ghost card slot sits on the screen, then the credit card drops in from above with a tilt and settles into place, its details fading on.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Fold app, light lavender-grey, Cards tab active in the Home/Insurance/Spaces/Cards bar: a rounded empty slot (dashed outline, faint card silhouette), "COMING SOON" chip, headline "Breathing room for your credit cards." with body copy, and a bottom bar with an Add card pill and tab icons.

## Motion spec
Pattern: empty-slot fill - the product card drops into its own placeholder.
- The dashed slot idles with a slow opacity breathe (opacity 0.5 -> 0.8, 2s).
- The credit card enters from above the slot (translateY -120 -> 0, rotateZ -8 -> 0 degrees, spring ~280/16), landing with a small overshoot bounce and a soft shadow that fades in under it (200ms).
- On landing, the card's printed details (network mark, number tail) fade in (250ms), and the slot's dashed outline dissolves (200ms) - the placeholder is consumed by the card.
- The card then idles with a gentle float (translateY +/-3px, 3s loop) and a slow sheen sweep across its face (one pass every 4s).

## Calibration
- The drop is physical but soft - a card placed on felt, not slammed on a table.
- Everything is desaturated lavender-grey except the card art, which carries the only saturated color.

## Reduced motion
Card fades in at rest position (300ms); no float or sheen.

## Don't miss
- The slot and the card are exactly the same size - the fill reads as materialization, not placement of a smaller object.
- The "COMING SOON" chip stays put through the whole animation.
